seoTitle: How to Use the Jotform PDF Editor Easily
metaDescription: Learn how to turn form submissions into print-ready PDF documents using Jotform's PDF Editor in 2026, with templates, branding, and automated rules.
intro: Turning raw form submissions into a polished, print-ready document is exactly what Jotform's PDF Editor is for, whether you're generating invoices or archiving signed contracts. This guide covers switching into the editor, applying a layout template, mapping submission fields, and automating delivery once a document is ready.

steps.heading: Launch the PDF Editor
steps.body: From your active project dashboard, switch from Jotform Tables or Form Builder into the PDF Editor panel.

steps.heading: Choose a layout template
steps.body: Browse the template library and select a professional, industry-specific base design to start from.

steps.heading: Customize branding elements
steps.body: Insert your company logo, add custom text blocks, and adjust grid margins to match your document style.

steps.heading: Map submission fields
steps.body: Choose exactly which form responses appear on the document by mapping and formatting dynamic submission data fields on the canvas.

steps.heading: Configure automation and download
steps.body: Set up rules to auto-email PDFs or password-protect files, then preview and test the live document download stream.

faq.question: Can I choose which submission fields appear on the final PDF?
faq.answer: Yes, you can manage which form responses show up on the document by mapping specific fields onto the PDF canvas.

faq.question: Can PDFs be automatically emailed to respondents?
faq.answer: Yes, advanced settings let you configure rules to auto-email the generated PDF to respondents after submission.

faq.question: Can I password-protect the generated PDF?
faq.answer: Yes, the PDF Editor includes an option to automatically password-protect files as part of its automation rules.

faq.question: Does the PDF Editor support company branding like logos?
faq.answer: Yes, you can drag in your logo and other brand assets while customizing the document layout.
